lines.zh: 我用三条鳍脚撑在海底。
lines.en: I prop myself on the seafloor with three fins.

lines.zh: 我挪几步，就停下来歇着。
lines.en: A few steps, then I rest.
I'm not much of a swimmer.
I move along the abyssal silt.

lines.zh: 我的鳍在泥上留下三个点。
lines.en: My fins leave three dots in the silt.

lines.zh: 三条鳍轮流挪，我调了个头。
lines.en: Three fins shift in turn; I turn around.
I move forward a short way.
The current pushes; I brace harder.

lines.zh: 我从一块骨头旁边走过。
lines.en: I walk past a bone.

lines.zh: 三只脚踩着海床慢慢挪。
lines.en: Three legs creep along the seabed.
I go around a trench, slowly.

lines.zh: 我一步一步地踏着海底。
lines.en: I step along the seabed, one at a time.
I leave shallow pits in the silt.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看了上面的水。
lines.en: I lift my head toward the water above.
My movements are slow and steady.
I stop between two stones.
I lie on the abyssal floor, unmoving.
The water above is deep and dark.

lines.zh: 我的三个鳍脚撑着身体。
lines.en: My three fins hold me up.
I listen to the sounds of the floor.
A small fish passes by.
My mouth opens a little.
There's no light here.
I press my body to the stone.
I wait for the current to ease.
I roll my eyes.

lines.zh: 沉淀物慢慢落在我背上。
lines.en: Silt settles slowly on my back.

lines.zh: 这地方安静得像没有水。
lines.en: It's so quiet it feels like no water at all.

lines.zh: 我数着自己呼吸的间隔。
lines.en: I count the gaps between my breaths.
I lie on the abyss floor, propped on fins.
You've swum down, slowly.
I'm in the silt by your feet.
I look up at you with no ill will.
I don't bite. I have no teeth for it.
Your light plays over me.

lines.zh: 我把三条鳍挪了个方向。
lines.en: I shift my three fins round.
What are you looking for?
The silt is deep here.

lines.zh: 我只会用鳍敲一敲海底。
lines.en: All I can do is tap the seabed with a fin.

lines.zh: 我的鳍脚在你靴底下动不了。
lines.en: My fin-feet can't move under your boot.
It hurts; I sink into the silt.
I sink slowly down.
That pressed me into the silt.

lines.zh: 我身上有泥沙混进伤口。
lines.en: Silt gets into the wound.

lines.zh: 我的鳍脚软了，撑不住身体。
lines.en: My fin-feet weaken and can't hold me up.
My eyes swim.
I shuffle behind the stone.
I can still hold myself up.
I prop myself on three fins.
I need a stone to lean on.
Those crumbs are drifting down.
I prop myself up and step over.

lines.zh: 三根鳍支在海底，我抬头。
lines.en: Three fins on the seabed, and I lift my head.
This will feed me a long while.
The current brings it to me.
On the seabed, my fins serve as legs.
No hurry; it can't get away.
I reach out a fin.

lines.zh: 碎屑落进泥里，我低头去拱。
lines.en: The crumbs sink into the mud; I root for them.
I shift toward the crumbs.
You touch me and I barely shift.
I move a fin aside.
The current presses us together.

lines.zh: 别推，我站得稳，三只脚插在海底。
lines.en: Do not push; three feet are planted on the seabed.
We collide and silt billows.
You step on my flank.
I lean toward that stone.
That swayed me gently.
I'm against you. Cold.
I draw back slowly.
Another rises out of the silt.
Our fins touch.
Its body is rounder than mine.
We lie side by side on the floor.
Its eyes never leave me.
We shift together slowly.

lines.zh: 两条尾巴在泥里划出弧。
lines.en: Two tails draw arcs in the silt.
Nothing else disturbs us here.

lines.zh: 我们一起朝着上面的暗水。
lines.en: Together we face the dark water above.
This floor has room for both of us.

lines.zh: 我把嘴贴到泥上，慢慢吸。
lines.en: I press my mouth to the mud and sip slowly.
I bring my mouth to the silt.
I take it in my mouth.
Too hard. I won't eat it.
Too heavy; I can only drag it.

lines.zh: 这东西卡在喉咙，我又咳出来。
lines.en: It sticks in my throat; I cough it back out.
I'm keeping it. Don't come near.

lines.zh: 我用三条鳍把食物圈在身下。
lines.en: I fence the food under me with three fins.
This will take a long time to finish.
I spit it out again.
Your boot presses my fin.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地把身子调过来。
lines.en: I slowly bring myself around.
I spread my fins wider.

lines.zh: 我没有什么力气，但我会顶。
lines.en: I'm not strong, but I can shove.
This silt is mine.

lines.zh: 我把三条鳍重新插进泥里。
lines.en: I plant my three fins back into the mud.
I lower my head at you.
I'll keep this in mind.
Walk away and I won't move.
I shift slowly toward you.
I follow along the silt.
You move a step; I move half.

lines.zh: 我三条腿撑着，趴在海底。
lines.en: On three fins, I rest on the seabed.
No need to hurry; I'm slower.
I turn broadside to block the way.
I raise one fin slowly.

lines.zh: 泥把我们的痕迹都盖了。
lines.en: Silt covers both our tracks.
I wait for that foot to come down.
It's dark; you'll misstep.
One more shuffle and I'm there.
I slap your foot with a fin.

lines.zh: 我用头顶你的膝，顶不动。
lines.en: I butt your knee with my head; it won't budge.
I butt you lightly.
You lift your foot and I back off.

lines.zh: 我贴在你的靴上，不肯动。
lines.en: I cling to your boot and won't move.

lines.zh: 我的身体压在你脚面上。
lines.en: My body presses on your foot.
That nudged you off balance.
You step away and I stop.
I turn back slowly.

lines.zh: 三条腿撑着，趴在渊海底。
lines.en: On three fins I rest on the abyss floor.
A small bulge rises in the abyssal silt.
I push myself up out of the silt.
One more tripod fish here.
I settle slowly onto the seabed.
A layer of silt settles on my back.

lines.zh: 我在两块石头之间停下。
lines.en: I come to rest between two rocks.
The current carried me here.
The floor is dark. Good.
I spread my three fins.
I lift my head and wait quietly.
The water warms and I can't move.

lines.zh: 我从石台上滑下去，摊在泥里。
lines.en: I slide off the ledge and sprawl in silt.

lines.zh: 我本该在水里，可这水太薄了。
lines.en: I belong in water, but this water is too thin.

lines.zh: 爆风把我从泥里掀起来。
lines.en: The blast lifts me out of the silt.

lines.zh: 一枚东西擦过我的身侧。
lines.en: Something grazes my flank.
That spell makes the water heavy.
This floor is too empty.

lines.zh: 我撑着三条鳍，坐在海沟底。
lines.en: I prop myself on three fins on the trench floor.
The water is drawn away and I fall.
